description: Solve a right-angle triangle from any two given values, at least one of which must be a side. Sides: a (opposite), b (adjacent), c (hypotenuse). angleA is angle A in degrees, between 0 and 90 (the third angle is the 90 degree right angle). Returns all three sides, both non-right angles, the area and the perimeter. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/triangle-calculator/

angleA.description: Angle A in degrees, strictly between 0 and 90

c.description: Side c, the hypotenuse (greater than 0, must be the longest side)
